fixes.problem: Native multi-GPU workers can share the same cache runtime. Concurrent stream iteration and insertion can raise OrderedDict mutated during iteration.
fixes.resolution: At the sampling owner, bypass caching entirely when native multigpu additional models are configured; preserve original options, arguments, result and exceptions.
fixes.scope: CPU controlled-thread reproduction and real ModelPatcher configuration checks; not a multi-GPU hardware or performance test.

fixes.problem: An object patch loaded by another clone can change the physical model and cause a valid native MOSS owner to be rejected during node installation.
fixes.resolution: Validate the effective diffusion model through ModelPatcher.get_model_object.
fixes.scope: Reproduced with public clone/add_object_patch/patch_model APIs, without manually creating backup state.

fixes.problem: Manual ZIP packaging omitted versioned review JSON files referenced by the public README and benchmark report. Registry CLI packaging already included these files.
fixes.resolution: Include public review-X.Y.Z.json records in the explicit manual package file list.

tests.scope: CPU suite including real miniature native MOSS; no model weights required

image_validation.scope: Saved Base/SFT canvas and timing evidence remains tied to 0.1.0. No new large-model quality, timing, or multi-GPU measurements are claimed.
